aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: A retained odd-n small fixture passed the same checkpoint-free worker on this host, emitting a candidate with exact count 1 and no checkpoints. This is a software-path control, not a degree-six positive instance.

decision_rule.text: Candidate output is recorded as candidate_unchecked with digest and bytes; a killed constant is projection_kills_one; errors and timeouts are failed. This producer run alone decides no LFD>=6 claim.

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoints, S3 uploads or restore. Retain write-once local stage transcripts and any candidate file; interruption is terminal for this one attempt.

inadmissible: Calling a killed constant a proved upper bound.
Calling a native candidate a certified nonmembership map before the independent D5 slice checker accepts it.
Inferring LFD>=6 from this producer result alone.

invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.
